description: Client-only, needs enableUiControl. Left-click a widget of the open screen, by id from get_ui or by its exact label (case-insensitive, must be unique). Returns the screen after the click. Refuses disabled widgets and the Quit Game, Realms and Reset Demo World buttons. For sliders, fraction picks the position (0 = left, 1 = right).

fraction.description: Where to click across the widget, 0..1 (default 0.5); sets a slider's value.

widget.description: Widget id from get_ui, or its exact label.

name: click_widget
title: Click a widget
